description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for SEC Form 13F-HR data, including query parameters, data structure, and data retrieval logic.

classes.name: SecForm13FHRQueryParams
classes.description: Class for SEC Form 13F-HR query parameters, extending base query params.

classes.name: SecForm13FHRData
classes.description: Class representing SEC Form 13F-HR data, extending base data class with additional fields and aliases.

classes.name: SecForm13FHRFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving SEC Form 13F-HR data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms a dictionary of parameters into a SecForm13FHRQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and parses SEC 13F-HR filings based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into a list of SecForm13FHRData instances, sorted by period ending and weight.
